description: This file defines classes and methods for managing subscription documents, subscription instances, and their history in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including creation, copying, and state management of subscriptions.

classes.name: subscription_document
classes.description: Represents a subscription document with associated fields and constraints.

classes.name: subscription_document_fields
classes.description: Defines fields for subscription documents, including default values.

classes.name: subscription_subscription
classes.description: Manages subscription instances, including creation, copying, and state transitions.

classes.name: subscription_subscription_history
classes.description: Tracks the history of subscription document generation.

methods.name: _get_document_types
methods.description: Fetches available document types and their models from the database.

methods.name: set_process
methods.description: Sets up a scheduled process (cron job) for the subscription.

methods.name: model_copy
methods.description: Copies a document based on the subscription's source document, updating the subscription state accordingly.

methods.name: set_done
methods.description: Marks the subscription and its cron job as completed.

methods.name: set_draft
methods.description: Resets the subscription to draft state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the write method for subscription_document to prevent model modification.
